title: Publish jobs with leased delivery records
pr_body: Adds a delivery receipt and leaves unacknowledged jobs eligible for retry.
author: codex
provenance: Original synthetic production-style change authored for benchmark v2.

files.before:
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Protocol


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Job:
    id: str
    body: bytes


class Store(Protocol):
    async def lease(self, job_id: str) -> str: ...
    async def release(self, token: str) -> None: ...


class Publisher(Protocol):
    async def publish(self, job: Job) -> None: ...


async def publish_job(job: Job, store: Store, publisher: Publisher) -> None:
    token = await store.lease(job.id)
    try:
        await publisher.publish(job)
    finally:
        await store.release(token)

bugs.title: Failed publish retains its lease
bugs.rationale: If publisher.publish raises, release is skipped. The job stays leased until expiry and cannot be retried promptly, unlike the prior finally block.
